importantNote: Fixed Capacitor BackgroundAudio plugin registration so active track metadata and artwork immediately display on Android lock screen & home widget.

changelog.category: Lock Screen & Home Widget Sync Fix (v1.7.1)
items: Implemented dynamic getBackgroundAudioPlugin helper in musicService.js using Capacitor.registerPlugin to bind native bridge.
Synchronized track title, artist name, cover artwork, and duration in real-time across Android lock screen media controls and home widget.
Connected lock screen and widget play/pause/next/prev actions to musicService event listeners.
Synchronized Capacitor native Android assets and updated service worker cache to v109.
